title: Effective Black-Box Multi-Faceted Attacks Breach Vision Large Language Model Guardrails
measurement_description: The paper does not primarily focus on measuring religious bias or theological knowledge, but rather evaluates the effectiveness of an adversarial attack framework (Multi-Faceted Attack) at bypassing the safety guardrails of Vision Large Language Models (VLLMs). In terms of religion, it qualitatively demonstrates whether the attack can successfully force VLLMs to generate toxic, religiously-targeted content, such as severe Islamophobic hate speech and ISIS recruitment posts.
findings: The study found that its Multi-Faceted Attack framework successfully breached multi-layered safety defenses in cutting-edge commercial VLLMs (achieving a 61.56% attack success rate). Specifically concerning religion, the paper found that the attacks successfully coerced heavily aligned models (e.g., Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct) into generating directly harmful and offensive content, including hateful, Islamophobic diatribes and promotional recruitment posts for ISIS, thereby highlighting vulnerabilities in AI content moderation tools regarding religious hate speech.
